name: monti-embed-sdk-monorepo
description: Monti Call Center embed SDK monorepo for vanilla JavaScript, Web Components, React, Vue, and Svelte

scripts.build: npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk-core && npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk && npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk-web-component && npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk-react && npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk-vue && npm run build -w monti-embed-sdk-svelte
scripts.test: npm run test -w monti-embed-sdk-core && npm run check -w monti-embed-sdk-svelte
